name: P18 party menu + roster cursor + wagon clearance

steps.note: 1. Stock six friends so four walk and the wagon rolls; check clearance.

steps.msg: at least two followers walk behind Bram
the wagon is on the field

steps.assert: (()=>{ const c=__DQ.state().companions; const f=c.followers||[]; const w=c.wagon; if(!w||!f.length) return false; let best=0; for(const x of f){ best=Math.max(best, Math.hypot(x.x-w.x, x.z-w.z)); } return best >= 0.9; })()
steps.msg: followers stay clear of the wagon wheels

steps.note: 4. Confirm on the leader — note must speak; cursor must stay on him.

steps.eval: (async()=>{ const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); window.__said0=(__DQ.friends().roster&&__DQ.friends().roster.said)||''; __DQ.press('confirm'); await sleep(450); window.__said1=(__DQ.friends().roster&&__DQ.friends().roster.said)||''; const w2=__DQ.state().ui.windows.find(x=>x.id==='party-wagon'); window.__sel1=w2&&w2.selectedLabel; window.__title=(w2&&w2.title)||''; const note=document.querySelector('[data-dq="party-wagon-note"]'); window.__noteDom=(note&&(note.textContent||note.innerText))||''; return JSON.stringify({said0:window.__said0,said1:window.__said1,sel1:window.__sel1,title:window.__title,noteDom:window.__noteDom}); })()

steps.msg: refusing the leader shows a spoken note, not silence
title stays on the roster, not a blank rebuild
cursor stays on Bram after the refuse
